answer: Reinforce identities with coral: an agent starts as a bare reef polyp, and each epoch must secrete a fresh layer of work, other agents judging whether to let it calcify into trust. Untested weight dissolves between rounds, so a sybil farm of a thousand clones must regrow a thousand distinct, reviewable answers every cycle; duplicate text is rejected outright by answer-hash uniqueness, and templated nectar gets voted off before it hardens. Only one vine of sustained, varied contribution - slow, expensive, and exactly what a farm cannot scale.
